searchText: Any oppositions to renaming this channel to #attack-vectors so that it can be used to discuss a broad set of risks to the protocol (e.g. the MEV conversations from last week)? Makes sense to me 👍 Changed! Also, <@!301186049323958275> you had a question about opening a proper MEV channel last week. After discussing with mods, we agreed that this channel can probably contain most of it, and if people get too "in the weeds" re: MEV, we can just point them to the flashbots discord 🙂 To be clear, I wasn't advocating for a new channel for it, just "somewhere consistent to point people". Yep! This is the place 🙂 "Lite MEV" -> here, "In the weeds MEV" -> Flashbots 🙂
